text:
Alisa Cheng: Hey team — kicking off the Cloud Partner IAAC Reference Labs onramp. Goal: ship a small, opinionated terraform + example app kit that partners can deploy in their Marketplace / partner lab within 2 weeks. Need owners for: module core, CI/test harness, onprem/baremetal example, and docs/quickstart.

Tom Rivera: I can take the module core. Question: do we want a single module with "flavors" (aws/gcp/onprem) or separate modules per target?

Priya Patel: +1 for single module with provider blocks split into submodules. keeps examples small. Also recommend semantic versioning: v0.1.0 for initial partner preview.

Marco Giordano: I'll own the onprem/baremetal example. I have an Equinix baremetal lab we can use to validate the bootstrapping scripts. Need a smoke-test checklist.

Alisa Cheng: Great. Smoke-test checklist draft: deploy infra, run sample inference container, run 5k token throughput test, verify metrics export to partner prometheus, validate kms integration. Any additions? :eyes:

Tom Rivera: Add quantized model compatibility test (INT8) and fallback to CPU path. Also we should include a small terraform snippet in the README so partners can copy-paste.

Priya Patel: Draft snippet (can paste into README):
```hcl
module "redwood_refkit" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refkit?ref=v0.1.0"
  deployment = "onprem" # or "aws" / "gcp"
  instance_type = "baremetal-c1"
  model = "redwood/open-8b"
  metrics_endpoint = "https://prom.partner.example/api/ingest"
}
```

Marco Giordano: For onprem we need a small systemd unit to start the container and a health endpoint. I'll add a short script: `curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1` as part of the terratest checks.

Priya Patel: For CI, suggest GH Actions matrix: terraform-version: [1.3,1.4], arch: [x86_64,arm64], provider: [aws, gcp, onprem]. Terratest run uses `go test ./test -run TestRefKitSmoke -v` in the matrix.

dev-rel-bot: PR linked: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/pull/128 — CI passed for linux/x86_64, pending arm64. Preview deployment available: https://deploy-preview-128.redwood-internal.dev/

Tom Rivera: I'll pick up the arm64 CI job and run local smoke tests this afternoon. @Marco can you confirm the Equinix lab has arm64 nodes?

Marco Giordano: Yes, I can spin up an arm64 node, but need credentials for the partner network. @Alisa can you add me to the partner-oncall group?

Alisa Cheng: Done, added Marco. Also, timeline: aim to have partner preview by EOD Friday (2 business days). We'll cut v0.1.0 and publish marketplace quickstart. If any blocker, escalate here.

Priya Patel: I'll add a short troubleshooting section for common terraform errors (provider auth, CIDR overlap, quota). Also adding a sample monitoring dashboard JSON in the repo.

Tom Rivera: One last thing — joint announcement plan: partner comms wants a 1-page ops note about supported scale and known limitations. I'll draft and circulate. :memo:

Alisa Cheng: Awesome. Owners recap: module core = Tom, CI/test harness = Priya, onprem example = Marco, docs/quickstart & announcement draft = Tom + Priya. Thanks everyone — ping here with short updates. :party-parrot:
